author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at a nasty setback in the age verification department. Most of the Internet by next year will require border checkpoints and unless we make a stand and teach people around us how invasive this really will be, our anonymity and freedom on here will be a fleeting memory. How do we stand up? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: i'm begging you to stand up and fight
